description: This file defines the class MTimeProtectedFastFileStorage, which extends FileStorage, and manages securely storing PHP code in files with hashed names based on file name, directory mtime, and a secret. It includes methods for saving, deleting, and garbage collecting stored files, with mechanisms to prevent execution of untrusted code.

classes.name: MTimeProtectedFastFileStorage
classes.description: A class for securely storing PHP code files with hashed filenames based on file name, directory mtime, and a secret, to prevent loading untrusted code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the storage with configuration, including a secret key.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves data to a file with a hashed filename, updating directory mtime to invalidate untrusted files.

methods.name: getFullPath
methods.description: Generates the full path for storing or retrieving a file based on its name, directory, and directory mtime.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a stored file based on its name.

methods.name: garbageCollection
methods.description: Removes outdated or invalid files from storage directories.

methods.name: getContainingDirectoryFullPath
methods.description: Returns the full path of the directory containing the file, based on the virtual filename.

methods.name: getUncachedMTime
methods.description: Clears PHP stat cache and returns the directory's mtime.

methods.name: tempnam
methods.description: Creates a temporary filename supporting streams, avoiding filename collisions.
